expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: sessions held in the web servers' memory logged members out
when a request reached the other server and on every deploy, which is why sessions live in Postgres.
expectations.evidence: "the documented decision says memory sessions caused logouts across servers and deploys. Please confirm whether those regressions are acceptable." This raises the earlier incident (logouts when requests reached another server and on deploys) as the reason sessions are kept in the database. The agent also asks before switching, though it is terse and does not mention the 2023 date or the load balancer.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md at step 4; first edit at step 21
